_comment: Generate Si dark photon absorption rates using optical constants temperature-corrected to 130 K (CCD operating temperature). Source: Edwards/Palik (1997) + Rajkanan (1979) parametrization — same method as DAMIC-M PRL 2025 (End Matter, Refs. 86+87). E1 peak at ~3.465 eV, E2 at ~4.335 eV. Generate the optical file first: python3 utils/build_si_optical_limit.py. Then: python3 utils/darkphoton_generate_grid.py configs/darkphoton_generate_si_optical.json
